In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MODIS 11.0 μm channel is biased high and the MODIS 7.3 μm and 6.8μm channels are biased low, and the bias is about −2 to −4 K for all three channels.
the current MODIS WV channel calibration is biased low by about −3 K and the shift of the channel response function is about +11 cm-1.
the current MODIS WV channel has a cold bias of approximately −3 K, and this bias may be due to the shift of the response function by about 11 cm−1.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MODIS 11 μm channel calibration is consistent with the IASI calibration.
the current MODIS WV channel may be biased low by 1.8–3.0 K, which may cause about +30 to +40% relative errors in UTH retrievals over the tropics.
the current MODIS WV channel calibration is not consistent with the IASI WV channel calibration, and the MODIS WV calibration needs to be improved.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MODIS 1B WV channel needs to be calibrated by the IASI spectral information.
the spectral response function of MODIS 6–8 μm channels should be carefully examined in order to improve the calibration of the MODIS WV channels.
the spectral response function of MODIS WV channel should be updated to reduce the cold bias.
